summary_claims.claim: Generating an altered sexual depiction without consent is a third-degree felony; 'generate' covers computer-generated means
Civil action lies against those who generate or possess to promote; USD 10,000 or actual damages

scope.note: Existing scope_note kept: not AI-specific, included for the generation offence.

note: Summary fix (civil action against generators and promoters, not every possessor) is supported by s. 836.13(7). No newer enactment found for this act.
